Based on my search, I can explain how to pronounce "doge" properly. The pronunciation actually differs depending on which meaning you're referring to:

## The Two Meanings of "Doge"

**1. The Internet Meme (Shiba Inu dog) / Cryptocurrency (Dogecoin)**

This is pronounced **/doʊdʒ/** — rhyming with "dodge." 

- UK: /dəʊdʒ/ (sounds like "dohj")
- US: /doʊdʒ/ (sounds like "dohj")

The word is a deliberate misspelling of "dog," and the community consensus is to pronounce it with a soft "g" sound (like the "j" in "jump"). According to Know Your Meme, Doge originated from a 2005 Homestar Runner puppet show where the character spelled out "d-o-g-e" as a quirky way of saying "dog."

**2. The Historical Title (Venetian/Genoese Ruler)**

This is traditionally pronounced **/doʊʒ/** in English — with a "zh" sound (like the "s" in "vision"):

- UK: /dəʊʒ/
- US: /doʊʒ/

This comes from Italian "Doge" (pronounced roughly /ˈdoːdʒe/), derived from Latin "dux" meaning "leader." However, some English speakers simplify this to /doʊdʒ/ as well.

## Quick Summary

| Context | Pronunciation | Sounds Like |
|---------|--------------|-------------|
| Meme / Dogecoin | /doʊdʒ/ | "dohj" (rhymes with "dodge") |
| Venetian ruler | /doʊʒ/ or /doʊdʒ/ | "dohzh" or "dohj" |

For the meme and cryptocurrency that most people refer to today, **"dohj"** (/doʊdʒ/) is the standard pronunciation. Some people mistakenly say "dog" or "doggy" or "dog-ee," but these are considered incorrect by the community.

Sources:
1. https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/doge
2. https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/doge
3. https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/doge
4. https://accenthero.com/app/pronunciation-practice/english/american/doge
5. https://www.cryptopolitan.com/how-do-you-pronounce-dogecoin/
6. https://memepediadankmemes.fandom.com/wiki/Doge
7. https://tieba.baidu.com/p/7611827332
8. https://pronouncebee.com/doge/
9. https://app.youglish.com/pronounce/doge/english
10. https://italianhistories.com/podcast/venice-a-saint-comes-to-venice/
